The '''muja fruit-filled donut''' was a [[Doughnut/Legends|donut]] which contained [[Muja fruit/Legends|muja fruit]] filling. On the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]], the [[Restaurant/Legends|eatery]] [[Dex's Diner/Legends|Dex's Diner]] served [[Adarian/Legends|Adarian]]-style donuts, including muja [[Fruit/Legends|fruit]]-filled donuts, which were prepared by a [[Dexter Jettster's Crisp-E-O donut droid|Crisp-E-O donut droid]]. The muja fruit-filled donut was considered a crowd pleasing standard by the eatery's owner, [[Dexter Jettster/Legends|Dexter Jettster]], and it was available for 1.7 [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]]<ref name="Dex" /> at some point no earlier than [[28 BBY/Legends|28 BBY]].<ref name="DexDates">{{Hyperspace|url=fans/hyperspace/source/dexdiner/index.html|text=Dining at Dex's|int=Dining at Dex's}} is set at some point no earlier than [[28 BBY/Legends|28 BBY]] per the {{DiningAtDexDate}}.</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
The muja fruit-filled donut was mentioned in the [[2009]] [[Hyperspace: The Official Star Wars Fan Club|Hyperspace]]-exclusive article "[[Dining at Dex's]]," written by [[Gregory Walker]] and formatted as an [[in-universe]] menu.<ref name="Dex" />
